title: Avin of Tzippori
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Shabbat 29b, it is related that he dragged a bench (on Shabbat) in a marble upper room before Rabbi Yitzchak ben Elazar.

As for Yuchasin’s statement “in chapter 3 of Horayot, in Reish Lakish’s time,” which puzzled Seder HaDorot: Hyman explains that a small error slipped into Yuchasin: those words belong to the adjacent entry Avin Ramaah, an explanation he regards as clear.

notes.text: The William Davidson vocalized text and translation of Shabbat 29b place Avin’s bench-dragging before Rabbi Yitzchak ben Elazar, not in a room above him. The upper room has a marble floor; Shisha is not a person here. Hyman attributes the chronological difficulty in Yuchasin to words misplaced from its adjacent Avin Ramaah entry.
